lines.text: At dawn on the first day of the week, the women went to the tomb, and an angel rolled away the stone.
The angel told the women that Jesus had risen and was going ahead of the disciples into Bethany.
Jesus met the women as they ran, and they grasped His feet and worshiped Him.
The chief priests gave the soldiers a large sum of money to say the disciples stole Jesus while they were away.
On the mountain in Galilee, Jesus told the eleven to make disciples of all nations and promised to be with them always.
